title: Selector
description: A selector (spec section 5.2). No key may be null.

key.description: A unit key, for providers that address units by key.

pos.description: Byte offset of the quote when it was recorded. A hint only.

prefix.description: Up to 48 characters that preceded the quote.

quote.description: Text that occurs in the unit.

suffix.description: Up to 48 characters that followed the quote.

symbol.description: Declaration path in a code resource.
